name: moon-phases
title: Moon Phases
description: The moon this week: discs pop in around tonight's, which swells in the middle with a soft halo.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas with prebuilt paths. Discs scale on UI-thread springs on arrival and on change. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Discs appear in place, tonight does not bounce and the percentage does not count.
a11y.screenReader: One label ("Waning Gibbous, 95% lit. Next full moon in 27 days").

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { MoonPhases } from '@/components/kinetik/moon-phases';

<MoonPhases phase={0.57} />;
```

## When to use

- Weather, tide, night sky and outdoors apps.
- Calendars that follow the lunar month.

## When not to use

- Astronomy that needs precision: the phase is yours to compute, and the row is a picture.

## Notes

- `phase` runs 0–1: 0 is new moon and 0.5 is full moon.
- Waxing moons are lit on the right, as seen from the northern hemisphere.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add moon-phases`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
